transcript:
Movement includes everyday activity as well as exercise. Choose an option that fits your ability, circumstances and available support.

Aerobic activity, muscle challenge, and balance or functional activity contribute in different ways. Minutes alone do not tell the whole story.

Choose a manageable opportunity and consider what would make it easier. A weekly target is not a pass or fail test.

Use guidance appropriate to your age and circumstances. The Explorer illustrates selected settings; it does not measure your body or decide what is safe for you.
